title: How a 22 year old built a million dollar app with AI

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: Did you know a 22-year-old just sold an AI app for $1 million?

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: AI is changing the game for young entrepreneurs like never before.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: He built an app that writes code for you using AI.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: His app uses a custom-trained model that understands natural language.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: It’s helping thousands of developers save hours every day.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: The key is combining AI with real-world problem-solving.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: What will you build with AI next?
